snippet.title: Dispatch | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Watch the launch trailer for Dispatch. The game is OUT NOW!

Steam: https://bit.ly/3WqpOIg 
PlayStation 5:  https://bit.ly/4qmjXRS
Switch 2: https://bit.ly/45exWQK
Switch: https://bit.ly/4p7XSEZ

Dispatch is a superhero workplace comedy where choices matter. Manage a dysfunctional team of misfit heroes and strategize who to send to emergencies around the city, all while balancing office politics, personal relationships, and your own quest to become a hero.

To keep up to date with our latest development visit https://dispatchgame.com/ and https://www.adhocla.com/  

Developed by AdHoc Studio.
